labour.title: Book labour by voice
labour.askWork: What kind of work do you need labour for? You can say
labour.askDate: On which day? Say today, tomorrow, or a date.
labour.askDays: For how many days? You can say skip for one day.
labour.askSession: Which part of the day? Full day, morning, or afternoon?
labour.noWorkers: No workers are available for {{work}} right now. Let's pick another kind of work.
labour.askWorker: Whom do you want to book? Say the name or the number.
labour.summary: Booking {{name}} for {{work}} on {{date}} for {{count}} day(s), {{time}}. Estimated cost {{amount}} rupees.
labour.success: Done! Your request has been sent to {{name}}. You will be told when they reply.

machinery.title: Rent a machine by voice
machinery.askCategory: Which machine do you need? You can say
machinery.noMachines: No {{type}} is available right now. Let's pick another machine.
machinery.askMachine: Which one do you want? Say the name or the number.
machinery.askRate: How do you want to rent it?
machinery.askDate: On which day do you need it? Say today, tomorrow, or a date.
machinery.askStart: At what time should it start? Say a time, or skip for 8 in the morning.
machinery.summary: Renting {{name}}, {{rate}}, on {{date}} for {{duration}}. Estimated cost {{amount}} rupees.
machinery.success: Done! Your rental request for {{name}} has been sent to the owner.

doctor.title: Book a doctor by voice
doctor.askKind: Do you need an animal doctor or a crop doctor?
doctor.noDoctors: No doctors are available right now.
doctor.askDoctor: Which doctor do you want? Say the name or the number.
doctor.askDate: On which day? Say today, tomorrow, or a date.
doctor.noSlots: No time is free on that day. Please choose another day.
doctor.askProblem: What is the problem? You can say
doctor.askAnimal: Which animal is it? You can say skip.
doctor.askCount: How many animals? Say skip for one.
doctor.askCrop: Which crop is it? You can say skip.
doctor.askSymptoms: Please describe what you see, in a few words.
doctor.summary: Consultation with {{name}} on {{date}} at {{time}} for {{problem}}. Fee {{fee}}.
doctor.success: Done! Your request has been sent to {{name}}.

nursery.title: Buy plants by voice
nursery.askQuery: Which plant are you looking for? Say its name, or say skip to see all.
nursery.noPlants: I could not find that plant. Let's try again.
nursery.askPlant: Which one do you want? Say the name or the number.
nursery.askQuantity: How many do you want? Say skip for one.
nursery.summary: Adding {{count}} {{name}} to your cart. About {{amount}} rupees.

market.title: Find products by voice
market.askQuery: What are you looking to buy? Say a product, or say skip to see everything.
market.noListings: I could not find that. Let's try again.
market.askListing: Which one do you want to open? Say the name or the number.

warehouse.title: Find a warehouse by voice
warehouse.askQuery: Which town or warehouse? Say a place or name, or say skip for the nearest ones.
warehouse.noWarehouses: I could not find a warehouse there. Let's try again.
warehouse.askWarehouse: Which one do you want to open? Say the name or the number.
